basic_info.description: First time on the market in over 35 years! This spacious single-family fixer upper is brimming with potential. Just steps from the prestigious St. Francis Wood neighborhood, this classic mid-century gem features an open concept living/dining area with a large fireplace, four bedrooms (including two primary suites) all on one level, plus ocean views from the top floor.    On the lower level, a large attached garage offers tremendous space for parking and storage.    Bring your vision (plus your designer or contractor) and transform this rare property into the home of your dreams!
